# EurekAlert!

> EurekAlert! is a science news distribution and discovery platform for research news releases, multimedia, and expert resources from institutions worldwide.

EurekAlert! publishes embargoed and public science news, institutional press releases, multimedia assets, and topic-based discovery pages for journalists, public information officers, and the public. The site also provides organizational information, submission guidance, and support resources for contributors and media users.

## News & Releases
- [News Releases](https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases): Browse the latest public science and research news releases across disciplines.
- [Breaking News](https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/breaking-news): View newly published and time-sensitive research announcements and updates.
- [All News Releases](https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases): Explore the full stream of research press releases from participating institutions.
- [Multimedia](https://www.eurekalert.org/multimedia): Access images, videos, audio, and other media accompanying research announcements.
- [Spotlight Releases](https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases): Discover featured and highlighted research stories selected for visibility.

## Topics & Subject Areas
- [Health](https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/health-medicine): Research news and releases related to health, medicine, and biomedical science.
- [Science](https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/science): Coverage of general science discoveries, methods, and institutional announcements.
- [Technology](https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/technology): News releases covering engineering, computing, and applied technology developments.
- [Environment](https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/environment): Research updates on climate, ecology, conservation, and environmental science.
- [Social Sciences](https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/social-behavioral): Releases focused on psychology, behavior, education, and society.
- [Business & Industry](https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/business-industry): News related to innovation, commercialization, and industry research activity.

## Search & Discovery
- [Advanced Search](https://www.eurekalert.org/advancedSearch): Search releases with filters for keywords, institutions, topics, and publication dates.
- [Latest News Search](https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases): Discover current releases through browsing and topic-based navigation.
- [Multimedia Search](https://www.eurekalert.org/multimedia): Find media assets associated with research announcements and institutional stories.
- [Topic Navigation](https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases): Browse releases by subject area and editorial category.
- [Institution Discovery](https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases): Explore research announcements from universities, journals, and organizations.

## For Journalists
- [For Journalists](https://www.eurekalert.org/for-journalists): Overview of journalist access, embargo policies, and reporting resources.
- [Media Registration](https://www.eurekalert.org/user/register): Register for journalist access to embargoed and public research news.
- [Embargo Policy](https://www.eurekalert.org/help/embargo-policy): Learn the rules governing embargoed research materials and access.
- [Press Kit](https://www.eurekalert.org/press-kit): Access organizational background and media-facing information about EurekAlert!.
- [Contact Us](https://www.eurekalert.org/contact): Reach EurekAlert! for support, media inquiries, and general questions.

## For Public Information Officers
- [For Public Information Officers](https://www.eurekalert.org/for-public-information-officers): Overview of services and publishing tools for institutional communicators.
- [Submit a News Release](https://www.eurekalert.org/submit): Guidance for submitting research news and related materials.
- [Membership Information](https://www.eurekalert.org/membership): Learn about eligibility, benefits, and participation for contributing organizations.
- [Submission Guidelines](https://www.eurekalert.org/help/submission-guidelines): Requirements and best practices for preparing releases and media assets.
- [Help Center](https://www.eurekalert.org/help): Find support articles for account, publishing, and policy questions.

## About EurekAlert!
- [About](https://www.eurekalert.org/about): Learn about EurekAlert!, its mission, and its role in science communication.
- [AAAS](https://www.aaas.org/): Visit the American Association for the Advancement of Science, EurekAlert!'s publisher.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.eurekalert.org/terms): Review the platform's terms governing site access and content use.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.eurekalert.org/privacy): Read how EurekAlert! handles personal data and privacy practices.
- [Accessibility](https://www.eurekalert.org/accessibility): Review accessibility information and commitments for the website.

## Account & Support
- [Sign In](https://www.eurekalert.org/user/login): Log in to access personalized features and embargoed content.
- [Register](https://www.eurekalert.org/user/register): Create an account for journalist or contributor access.
- [Help](https://www.eurekalert.org/help): Browse support resources for using the platform and managing accounts.
- [Contact](https://www.eurekalert.org/contact): Get assistance with technical issues, membership, or editorial questions.
- [Newsletters](https://www.eurekalert.org/newsletters): Subscribe to updates and curated research news alerts.

## Policies & Guidance
- [Embargo Policy](https://www.eurekalert.org/help/embargo-policy): Official policy for handling embargoed research news and journalist access.
- [Submission Guidelines](https://www.eurekalert.org/help/submission-guidelines): Editorial and formatting guidance for contributed news releases.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.eurekalert.org/terms): Legal terms governing use of the EurekAlert! platform and content.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.eurekalert.org/privacy): Data collection, processing, and privacy information for site users.
- [Help Center](https://www.eurekalert.org/help): Central support hub for policies, workflows, and troubleshooting.
